A boy took his bike to the park to go on a hike. He drank milk and ate cake for a snack. He bent down to pick up a stick in case he felt weak. He saw a snake by a rock and did a quick check. “Time to go back,” he said. “I will take my bike home and read a book instead!” Un niño llevó su bicicleta al parque para ir de caminata. Bebió leche y comió pastel de merienda. Se agachó para recoger un palo por si se sentía débil.
